initiatives.name: SPDC Nigeria Divestment
initiatives.summary: Shell completed the sale of The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited (SPDC) to Renaissance. With effect from January 1, 2025, SPDC ceased routine flaring operations.

evidence.title: Sale of SPDC completed
evidence.summary: Shell completed the sale of The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited (SPDC) to Renaissance. With effect from January 1, 2025, SPDC ceased routine flaring operations.
evidence.quote: This target was subject to the completion of the sale of The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited (SPDC). With effect from January 1, 2025, SPDC ceased routine flaring. On March 13, 2025, Shell completed the sale of SPDC to Renaissance.

initiatives.name: Elimination of Routine Flaring (Upstream)
initiatives.summary: Shell achieved its target to eliminate routine flaring from Upstream operations by 2025. With effect from January 1, 2025, Shell no longer carries out any routine flaring at its Upstream operations.

evidence.title: Elimination of routine flaring achieved
evidence.summary: Shell achieved its target to eliminate routine flaring from Upstream operations by 2025. With effect from January 1, 2025, Shell no longer carries out any routine flaring at its Upstream operations.
evidence.quote: With effect from January 1, 2025, Shell no longer carries out any routine flaring at its Upstream operations.

initiatives.name: Oil Products Customer Emissions Reduction
initiatives.summary: Shell set an ambition to reduce customer emissions from the use of its oil products by 15-20% by 2030 compared to 2021 baseline. Customer emissions from oil products were 517 million tonnes CO2e in 2023, showing a 14% decline compared to 2021.

evidence.title: Oil products customer emissions reduction ambition
evidence.summary: Shell set an ambition to reduce customer emissions from the use of its oil products by 15-20% by 2030 compared to 2021 baseline. Customer emissions from oil products were 517 million tonnes CO2e in 2023, showing a 14% decline compared to 2021.
evidence.quote: Oil products ambition Reduce customer emissions from the use of our oil products by 15-20% by 2030, Scope 3, Category 11 [C] (2021 baseline)

initiatives.name: Net-Zero Emissions Strategy and Targets
initiatives.summary: Shell has committed to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050 with multiple interim targets including halving Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 and reducing net carbon intensity by 15-20% by 2030. The company has already achieved a 30% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions compared to 2016 baseline.

evidence.title: Updated global policy positions alignment
evidence.summary: Shell updated its global climate and energy transition policy positions in March 2024 to align with its Energy Transition Strategy 2024, and made further updates in May 2025 to reflect evolving strategy and external developments.
evidence.quote: In March 2024, we updated our global policy positions to align with Shell's Energy Transition Strategy 2024. Then in May 2025, we made updates to some of these positions to reflect our evolving strategy and external developments.

evidence.title: Net-zero emissions target by 2050 with interim targets
evidence.summary: Shell has committed to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050 with multiple interim targets including halving Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2030 and reducing net carbon intensity by 15-20% by 2030. The company has already achieved a 30% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions compared to 2016 baseline.
evidence.quote: Shell has set a target to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. To help us get to net zero, we have also set short-, medium- and long-term targets to reduce the carbon intensity of the energy products we sell, measured by using our net carbon intensity metric.

initiatives.name: Pavilion Energy LNG Trading Acquisition
initiatives.summary: Shell acquired Pavilion Energy, which includes a global LNG trading business based in Singapore. This acquisition strengthens Shell's LNG trading capabilities and presence in the Asian market.

evidence.title: Acquisition of Pavilion Energy completed
evidence.summary: Shell acquired Pavilion Energy, which includes a global LNG trading business based in Singapore. This acquisition strengthens Shell's LNG trading capabilities and presence in the Asian market.
evidence.quote: In April 2025, we acquired Pavilion Energy, which includes a global LNG trading business, based in Singapore.
